actual: After BUG-208, merge-finalizer can reuse an existing close-sync PR and cleanup the source worktree, but the authorized full aftercare run still leaves the close-sync worktree/branch to be cleaned by a separate cleanup-after-merge command. The planned next phase requires merge-finalizer --merge-close-sync-pr --cleanup --apply to merge the close-sync PR, sync root, cleanup the source worktree/branch, and cleanup the close-sync worktree/branch in the same retry-safe state machine without root pollution or manual extra steps.
